data.body: MERGED as commit f0cf30a0e (Gerrit change 978), LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1. AC evidence: (1) inherited union signed — test_container_dep_set_inherits_the_children_union parses the manifest dep lines and sees {a.py, b.py}; (2) poison rule — test_container_poison_rule_keeps_the_pre_change_set asserts manifest_deps == {} and the claim BLOCKED after an unrelated commit (whole-HEAD fallback stays fail-closed); (3) closed children neither contribute nor poison — test_container_closed_children_neither_contribute_nor_poison; (4) claim outcomes — test_container_unrelated_commit_does_not_invalidate (claim survives) and test_container_child_declared_file_drift_invalidates (claim blocked naming drift); (5) pin self-healing — test_child_impact_edit_invalidates_the_container_attestation (under verify.enforce_plan_material_pins=true, the documented pairing); (6) P9 container-aware — three unit tests in tests/unit/test_plan_review.py (effective inheritance passes, poisoning advisory names the child id, closed children do not poison); (7) docs/plan-review-gate.md + ADR 0002 decision-5 amended. Implementation followed the plan's reviewed design: children threaded from the orchestrator's assembled context (no new store reads; resign path conservatively uninherited); P9 relocated to det_lint for the 800-LOC cap. Gates: lint/typecheck green, targeted suites green, Verified +1 on the change tree.
